content: Long-tail AI clippers: quso.ai (ex-vidyo.ai) adds scheduling to 6 platforms and analytics, free 75 credits/month, paid from about USD 19/month; Spikes Studio targets general creators from YouTube/Twitch/TikTok; Eklipse is gamer/streamer-focused (highlights from Twitch/Kick/YouTube, 1000+ games, voice commands, auto-post to TikTok/Shorts/Reels, mobile app); 2short.ai is YouTube-link-first with center-stage facial tracking and animated captions; Wisecut does silence removal with auto-zoom, auto subtitles in 13 languages, smart music, auto-reframe for podcasters/educators. Convergent feature set: clip detection + reframe + captions + score/sort, all cloud.
